name: pymoo
title_zh: 多目标优化：一次跑出整条帕累托前沿
tagline_zh: 调参只给一个解？工程上要的是权衡。NSGA-II/III、MOEA/D 内置，ZDT/DTLZ 基准齐。
tagline_en: One solution isn't enough for real trade-offs. NSGA-II/III, MOEA/D built-in, ZDT/DTLZ benchmarks ready—see the.
desc_en: Multi-objective optimization framework. NSGA-II, NSGA-III, MOEA/D, Pareto fronts, constraint handling, benchmarks (ZDT, DTLZ), for engineering design and optimization problems.
why_zh: 不是调包侠：约束处理、种群初始化、终止准则都暴露成可改参数，能嵌进你自己的评估循环，而不是被框架牵着走。
why_en: Not a black box: constraint handling, initialization, and termination are all exposed—drop it into your own evaluation loop.
limit_zh: 只覆盖连续/离散参数型优化，不碰组合爆炸的离散搜索（如 TSP）。目标函数必须能写成 Python 函数。
limit_en: Only for parameter-based optimization, not combinatorial search (e.g., TSP). Objectives must be Python-callable; wrap your simulator yourself.
